g.text: Each acquisition includes five probe repeats. Run 01 was designated primary before execution.
Recall is 100% at every stage in both datasets. Intel also has zero false groups after filtering.
These are repeated runs of one fixed input/seed, not ten different inputs or a matched ten-run Intel sample.
